sources.label: Material You, ad and tracker removal, and premium unlocks for Android apps.
sources.author: Fakh
patch_list: Makes "Sign in with Google" work. Signs in through microG RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services, so it needs microG RE installed and signed in to a Google account.
Removes the "App Mall" row from the Me tab.
Removes the Mall tab from the bottom navigation.
Removes the promo banner ("Enjoy Your Smart Life") and the ad slot from the Me tab.
Lets the patched app start. A patched app is signed with a different key, which the app's integrity check rejects, so without this it closes a few seconds after it opens.
